description: Keyword search over the catalog: dataset names, titles, descriptions, tags, and column names and descriptions. Returns short dataset summaries ranked by relevance, with the fields that matched, plus `dimension_matches` when the words also match a lookup table (e.g. 'district'). Acronyms work, including the short ones 'ap', 'el', and 'ib'. Use it to find a dataset when you know the subject but not the dataset's name.

limit.description: Most results to return (default 20, at most 100).
limit.title: Limit

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. 'graduation rate'.
query.title: Query

name: search_datasets
title: Search Datasets
